title: Synthetic movie likes, shares and subscribes
intent: Generate synthetic data of movie likes, shares and subscribes
rationale: Nemotron 3 Super writes schema-checked rows in batches with realistic distributions, and data-prep validates, dedupes and profiles them. No training: the dataset is the result, with a download link and a per-field stats card.

inputs.instructions: Events of a streaming service over the last 30 days. About 60% like, 30% share, 10% subscribe; devices about 45% mobile, 30% tv, 20% web, 5% tablet; around 150 distinct users (ids like u_00042), some far more active than others; real, varied movie titles from several decades and genres; ISO-8601 UTC timestamps with more events in the evening.
